+                         backend_base: str | None = None,
+                         poster=None) -> dict:
+    """Post the verdict and persist its outcome with the task evidence.

+    Evidence files are terminal task records; retaining the delivery status
+    alongside them prevents a successful verdict POST from disappearing when
+    the resident process exits.
